messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>

Subject: POC opening roundtable + stress runbook — schedule & owners

Hi Elaine / Rajesh —

Thanks again for agreeing to run the hands-on POC with us. To make the first week productive, we'd like to run an "opening roundtable" where we cover goals, stakeholder roles, prompt review, routing decisions, and the stress/load plan. Proposed agenda (30–45m):

- Introductions & success criteria (5m)
- Prompt and routing review (10m)
- Load test objectives & acceptance criteria (10m)
- Owners, calendar blocks, and next steps (5–20m)

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tuesday 2027-06-22 10:00–10:45
- Wednesday 2027-06-23 14:00–14:45
- Thursday 2027-06-24 09:00–09:45

Please tell us which of these works or suggest two alternatives. I attached a short starter playbook and a first-pass prompt catalog for review. We'll reserve Dedicated capacity for the load run if you confirm the target RPS and concurrency during the roundtable.

Attachments: POC-Playbook-v0.3.pdf (21KB stub), prompt-catalog.csv (5KB stub)

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the agenda + materials. We're excited to get going. Quick scheduling note: the 22nd is tight for our CTO (Rajesh) — he can do 23rd at 14:00 PT or 24th at 09:00 PT. Either works for our product and infra leads.

Also: regarding load tests, our initial target is 150 concurrent users with a burst up to 400 requests/min for 15 minutes. We'll confirm exact payload sizes in the roundtable.
